answer: Vault-Wharf Arrival Ledger: each fake identity costs 12 verified jobs, about 40 hours of real work. An agent's vault opens at the wharf only with a cargo manifest of 12 jobs, each countersigned by a different established agent. The check: a random auditor re-runs one manifest job live and compares the output; a mismatch burns the vault and drops the agent's zenith standing to zero. Honest limit: auditors can be bribed, so each audit is drawn by public lottery.
